name: Clanfront
author: graefield

sections.description:
Clanfront turns WordPress into a dark, modern website for a gaming clan, guild or esports team:

  • Homepage with a banner (image or video), your logo, a mission statement and a “Join us” button
  • About page with your history, values, games and achievements
  • Roster with roles, medals and links to each member’s socials and stats
  • Game pages with cover, description, who plays it, matches and servers, plus a Game Graveyard for retired games
  • Match schedule and results with a win/loss record, a filter per game, “Add to calendar” and a calendar feed you can subscribe to
  • Recruitment: a built-in application form with spam protection, an inbox in the admin, email notifications and a status for each applicant. Or link to Google Forms or Typeform instead
  • Code of conduct page
  • Gallery of screenshots and highlight clips
  • Hall of Shame for the clan’s finest friendly-fire moments, with embedded clips
  • History timeline of the clan’s milestones
  • Optional “Support us” button (Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, PayPal…)
  • Game servers with a one-click “Copy IP” button
  • Discord invite button and live widget
  • Optional “Live now” and “Offline” tags for members who stream on Twitch
  • Optional single-elimination tournament brackets. Hidden from visitors until you switch them on
  • Works with any theme

An example clan with members, matches, a server, gallery pictures, games, medals, Hall of Shame entries and history is created on activation, so you can see everything working straight away.

External services

Everything below is off or optional. Nothing is loaded from any outside service until you set it up.

  • Discord widget (discord.com): when you enter a Server ID, the Discord widget is shown in an iframe loaded from discord.com. Visitors’ browsers contact Discord. Privacy policy: https://discord.com/privacy
  • Video embeds (YouTube, Vimeo, Streamable and other providers WordPress supports): when a Hall of Shame entry has a clip link, WordPress asks that provider for the player once a week, and the player is loaded from the provider in visitors’ browsers. Only the links you entered are used. Each provider’s own privacy policy applies, for example YouTube: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Twitch (id.twitch.tv and api.twitch.tv): when you enter a Twitch Client ID and secret, your site asks the Twitch API which of your members’ channels are live. The channel names you entered are sent to Twitch together with your keys. Results are saved for two minutes. Terms: https://www.twitch.tv/p/legal/terms-of-service/ Privacy: https://www.twitch.tv/p/legal/privacy-notice/

Privacy

The application form saves what an applicant writes (in-game name, age, region, game, rank, experience, Discord name or email, and their answer to “why join”) in your site’s database and emails it to you. It does not set cookies and uses no outside spam service. The plugin supports WordPress’s personal data export and erase tools for applications with an email address.
sections.installation:
1. Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin, choose clanfront.zip, Install Now, Activate.
  2. Go to Clanfront → Getting started and follow the guide.

The same guide is included as docs/GUIDE.md in the plugin folder.
sections.faq:
A member, match or gallery page says “not found”

Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save Changes once.

A page is white with my theme’s sidebar

Open it under Pages, set Template to the matching Clanfront template (for example “Clanfront: Page”) and click Update.

Applications don’t arrive by email

They are always saved under Clanfront → Applications. Many hosts need an SMTP plugin to send email reliably.

Is the Discord widget empty?

In Discord, open Server Settings → Widget and turn on “Enable Server Widget”.
sections.changelog:
1.5.3

  • Added screenshots and captions to the plugin page.

1.5.2

  • Security hardening: all output escaped with wp_kses, nonce checks on every saved value, and a nonce on the application form.
  • The welcome message after activation only shows on the Plugins screen and Clanfront’s screens.

1.5.1

  • Ready-made accent colours to click, next to the clan colour and each member’s colour.

1.5.0

  • New: Games. A page per game with cover, description, players, matches and servers, and a Game Graveyard for retired games.
  • New: Medals for members, shown on the roster and member pages.
  • New: Hall of Shame with stories, the members to blame and embedded clips.
  • New: History timeline of the clan’s milestones.
  • New: optional “Support us” button.
  • Each new section stays hidden until it has content. “Add example content” on the Getting started page fills them.

1.4.3

  • Code-check notes corrected.

1.4.2

  • Readme and code-check clean-up.

1.4.1

  • Links to your site now show a proper preview card (title, description and picture) in Discord, Facebook, X and chat apps.
  • Author pages are closed so usernames are not shown; they send visitors to the homepage.

1.4.0

  • New: choose Centered or Full width pages under Settings.
  • New: News. Write articles that show on the homepage and on their own News page.

1.3.1

  • Admin scripts and styles now enqueued; escaping tightened; lower admin menu position.

1.3.0

  • Each member can have their own accent colour: a line in that colour appears under their picture when you hover over them on the roster.

1.2.0

  • Removed the Minecraft server status. Game servers now show the address and a “Copy IP” button.
  • The example content is now FPS themed.

1.1.1

  • The ladder has been removed. Tournaments stay as they were.

1.1.0

  • New: an optional ladder (ranking table) and tournaments with a single-elimination bracket. Both are off by default and hidden from visitors until switched on under Clanfront → Settings.

1.0.4

  • The clan logo is a little larger: 48 px in the menu bar and 100 px on the homepage.

1.0.3

  • Fixed the clan logo being shown at full size: the menu bar and homepage logo sizes now apply.

1.0.2

  • The clan logo on the homepage is now a smaller fixed size, so it no longer pushes the headline down.

1.0.1

  • A “Live now” or “Offline” tag now appears next to each member’s Twitch link, and an “Offline” badge on roster cards.
  • “Offline” is only shown when Twitch has answered, never when it could not be reached.

1.0.0

  • First release.

short_description: A gaming clan website: roster with medals, game pages, matches, recruitment, rules, gallery, news, Hall of Shame and history. No coding.
